Agent rows now carry the agent's name, the same one the footer list shows.

- `/desk-activity` lanes and agent rows, the progress band, background task cards and the "Waiting for … agents" rows labelled every agent with its type, so three `general-purpose` agents looked alike. They now show the name SendMessage addresses (`route-agent`, `save-agent`, …), and fall back to the type when an agent has none. The task detail still lists the type under Kind

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
